test_gaps.detail: Evidence framing limits. The library captures are scrolled so the header and tabs are off-screen, and the narrow target row is cut. Rename is captured with a single session, so 其他会话项不变 cannot be observed. timeline-three-rounds is proven only by the top/bottom pair. The failed card's 详情 and the after-restart narrow image are off-screen or collapsed. journey.json's UI readback records reason:null for the cancelled attempt, although the screenshot shows 这次生成被手动停止: the probe reads only failure reasons.

experience_gaps.detail: Composer draft is global: while viewing session B, the composer holds A's prompt. This is round-1 N-06, still open.

visual_quality_gaps.detail: At 900×700 the expanded card's large image is shrunk until the whole card fits the timeline. The card also carries the 96px header thumbnail, the header prompt, a second copy of the full prompt, 高级参数 and the action row, so little height is left and the 大图 ends up at or near thumbnail size. I opened three captures. busy-other-media-narrow: the large image is 96px, the same size as the thumbnail directly above it. verify-selected-full-size-narrow: a 1024×1024 image shows at about 110px. real-attempt-selected-actions-narrow: about 149 CSS px, against the 96px thumbnail. Wide captures get about 182–247px. Nothing is clipped, and both action buttons are now fully visible, so round-1 U-01/U-02 are fixed. The way U-02 was fixed (capping the image by the space left in the timeline) caused this regression: at the narrow width the page's main output can no longer really be viewed.
raised_by: reviewer-1:R1-batch-A-harness-003 (minor, same cause: expanded card repeats the thumbnail and prompt)
reviewer-1:R1-batch-B-real-app-001 (minor, same cause in the real app)
visual_quality_gaps.repair_suggestion: Remove the duplication before growing the image. When a card is expanded, hide the header thumbnail (the large image replaces it) and shorten the header prompt to the one-line summary; the full prompt stays under the image. This frees about 130px at 900×700. Then give the large image a real floor, e.g. max-height: min(60vh, ) with min-height ≈ 240px, and when the floor wins, scroll the card so the actions stay reachable (keep the round-1 U-01 scroll-into-view behaviour) instead of shrinking the image further. Add an e2e assertion at 900×700 that the expanded is rendered at ≥ 2× the thumbnail height and that the action buttons are inside the timeline box. Re-capture every listed narrow state in both batches. The contract needs a matching change (routed as follow-up in the closure audit): add a minimum rendered size for 大图 to attempt-selected-actions / timeline-three-rounds in visual-acceptance-criteria.md/.json, so the next round has no reason to disagree.

visual_quality_gaps.detail: In the real app's delete dialog (WKWebView), 取消 shows no visible focus ring, so the must-show 「取消」获得焦点 cannot be confirmed from pixels. I opened both captures. The harness delete-confirm-wide (Chromium) shows a clear blue ring on 取消. The real-delete-confirm-wide does not, and the list item behind the dialog keeps its blue double outline. So either focus is not moved in WKWebView, or :focus-visible is not applied to programmatic focus there. journey.json does not record the focused element.

When the 生成中 badge shows, the session title in the list is cut to 3–4 characters (会失败的…, 甲会话：…, 删除时还…) although about 90px is free. Width appears to be reserved for edit/delete buttons that are not rendered. This is round-1 N-02 and is not yet fixed.
The bottom edge of the 新会话 button touches the first session item's border with no gap, on every image-page screenshot.

Copy details. The empty state says 点「生成图片」 while the button is disabled (model-missing, runtime-unavailable). The title has a stray space after a full-width comma (清晨的港口， 渔船…). In the narrow header, status chips shrink to the vague 媒体：忙 × 忙.
The selected session's trash button is solid red with a double focus ring at rest (after restart). It is loud but not a defect.
